text:
maya: Aurora Ops asked for a short perf/W + p95/p99 throughput bench to finalize marketplace numbers. They want kernel tuning artifacts and an embargoed figure pack. Can we run next week?

frank: Do they provide VPN and PDU telemetry? Which model/seq lengths?

oliver-aurora: We can open VPN + perfmon on rigs alpha1/alpha2 by Mon EOD. Will expose PDU and per-socket power. Suggested model = aurora-lite (512 and 2048).

li: Proposed matrix: modes=fp16,int8,q4_0; kernels=stock,fused-attn,cublas-tuned. Powercap sweep: 300/250/200W. Include KV-cache thrash and a sustained 45m steady-state window for perf/W.

maya: Owners: Frank (bench ops), Li (kernel tuning), Maya (PM + announce), Oliver (partner contact). Agreed?

frank: Agreed. Dry-run Wed, tuning Thu, final sweep Fri if VPN up. Need partner to allow perfmon & kernel debug symbols.

bench-bot: Scheduled run created id=bench-1790012345 start=1790090000. Tests queued: baseline,int8,q4_0.

li: Pin driver stack in logs please: nvidia-driver 535.86, CUDA 12.1, cuBLAS 12.1. Kernel knobs we'll try: ATTEN_FUSE=1, CUBLAS_TUNE=3. Also run with powercap toggled.

oliver-aurora: Alpha1 can match that stack; Alpha2 is on older driver, will note compatibility. VPN/perfmon will be enabled Mon morning.

maya: Telemetry minimal list: run_id, ts, host_pdu_w (1s), socket_w, gpu_power_w, latency p50/p95/p99, ipc, l2_miss. We can share aggregated CSVs + PNGs; raw traces require NDA addendum.

legal-bot: Raw kernel traces are sensitive. NDA addendum recommended before sharing raw dumps; aggregated artifacts okay.

frank: Runner snippet for ops:
```bash
run-bench --model aurora-lite --seq 2048 --modes fp16,int8,q4_0 \
  --dur 2700 --powercaps 300,250,200 \
  --telemetry s3://redwood-partner-aurora/bench-1790012345 \
  --rigs alpha1,alpha2
```

li: Add quality gate: compute token logprob delta vs baseline and fail if avg drop >0.6. Also attach 10 sample generations per run.

maya: Timeline: Mon partner enables VPN; Wed dry-run; Thu tuning; Fri final sweep. Aurora wants an embargoed figure pack by next Tue for their comms. Can we deliver?

li: Yes if tuning goes smooth. Add one day buffer for regressions.

frank: Action items: 1) Oliver enable VPN+perfmon Mon AM. 2) Bench ops prep harness and dashboard. 3) Kernel team provide knobs + safe defaults. 4) PM open NDA addendum with Legal for raw traces. 5) Marketing draft embargoed playbook.

oliver-aurora: Confirmed; I'll enable VPN+perfmon Mon AM and start NDA flow. Excited to get this into the marketplace.

maya: I'll send the kickoff note to Oliver and copy Legal + Marketing. Will post the dry-run link after Wed. Thanks all! :rocket:
